name: @elasticpath/plasmic-mcp

tools.name: project

projectId.description: The Plasmic project ID (required for 'set' and 'add-package')

branchId.description: Branch ID to load (omit for main branch). Use branch.list to get available branch IDs.

batchId.description: Optional batch ID for verification (used by 'end-batch')

pkgId.description: Package ID for 'remove-package' and 'upgrade-package' (optional for upgrade-all)

syncMode.description: Dev-host sync behavior on 'set' / 'refresh' / 'sync-dev-host'. Default 'full' ingests newly-registered code components into site.components. 'variants-only' skips ingestion (faster, preserves legacy behavior). Overrides the PLASMIC_MCP_SKIP_DEV_HOST_INGESTION env var.

tools.name: inspect

componentUuid.description: UUID of the component to inspect

nodeRef.description: Node reference: UUID, name, path, or index

maxDepth.description: Maximum tree depth to return. Defaults to 3 for tree, 2 for summary. Pass -1 for unlimited.

maxChars.description: Character budget for response JSON. Defaults to 15000 (~4000 tokens). Pass -1 for unlimited.

excludeStyles.description: Strip styles from output to reduce size

summaryOnly.description: Return compact outline (same as summary action)

format.description: Response format. "concise" strips UUIDs (except root), abbreviates keys (childCount→cc, componentName→comp), replaces detail fields with booleans. ~70% token reduction for orientation. Default: "full".

pageParams.description: For preview-url on page components: path-param values to substitute into the pageMeta.path template. e.g. {slug:"test-product"} on route /product/[slug] → /preview/product/test-product. Unspecified keys fall back to pageMeta.params defaults.

pageQuery.description: For preview-url on page components: query-string values appended as ?k=v. Merged over pageMeta.query defaults.

tools.name: component

anyOf.description: Plain text string — creates an inline text node

tag.description: HTML tag: h1, h2, h3, p, span, div (default: div)

styles.description: CSS styles in camelCase, e.g. {fontSize:'16px', color:'#333'}

children.description: Nested PlasmicElement(s) — same format as the parent element. Single element object or array of elements.

tag.description: HTML tag: div, section, nav, header, footer, main, article, aside, ul, ol, li (default: div)

anyOf.description: Container element — vbox for vertical, hbox for horizontal, box for free layout

src.description: Image URL (omit to set later via set-image)

name.description: Component name as shown in Studio

anyOf.description: Code component or Plasmic component instance

nodeRef.description: Node reference for extract (UUID, name, path, or index)

description.description: Page description for SEO (update-page-meta) or prop description (add-prop/update-prop)

defaultValue.description: Default value for prop or initial value for state

includeImplicit.description: Include implicit states in list-states (default: false)

tools.name: node

nodeRef.description: Node reference: UUID, name, path, or index

parentRef.description: Parent node reference (for add, reorder, clone)

anyOf.description: Plain text string — creates an inline text node

tag.description: HTML tag: h1, h2, h3, p, span, div (default: div)

styles.description: CSS styles in camelCase, e.g. {fontSize:'16px', color:'#333'}

children.description: Nested PlasmicElement(s) — same format as the parent element. Single element object or array of elements.

tag.description: HTML tag: div, section, nav, header, footer, main, article, aside, ul, ol, li (default: div)

anyOf.description: Container element — vbox for vertical, hbox for horizontal, box for free layout

src.description: Image URL (omit to set later via set-image)

name.description: Component name as shown in Studio

anyOf.description: Code component or Plasmic component instance

slot.description: Target slot name on component instance

props.description: Component props to set (scalar, $expr, {{expr}}, PlasmicElement for slots, null to remove)

variant.description: Target variant by name, UUID, or selector

visible.description: Visibility: true (visible), false (not rendered — removed from DOM), 'hidden' or 'displayNone' (CSS display:none — hidden but stays in DOM)

patternName.description: Pattern name for apply-pattern action (use inspect.list-patterns to see available patterns)

tools.name: variant

nodeRef.description: Node reference to scope style variant

name.description: Name for variant group or variant

minWidth.description: Minimum viewport width in pixels for screen variants

maxWidth.description: Maximum viewport width in pixels for screen variants

tools.name: design

tokenType.description: Token type filter or creation type

styles.description: CSS styles at this keyframe stop

assetType.description: Asset type filter or creation type

tools.name: data

condition.description: JS condition expression or null to remove

collection.description: JS array expression or null to remove repetition

elementVariable.description: Loop variable name for each item

functionCall.description: For update-query on a serverQuery: bind the query's op to a registered custom function. Shape: {namespace, name, args: {argName: jsExpressionString}}. Pass null to clear the op (detach). The function must exist in site.customFunctions — run project.sync-dev-host if the dev host was just updated.

value.description: Value for data token or token update

tools.name: interaction
branch

sourceBranchId.description: Source branch ID to branch from (for create)

status.description: Branch status: active, merged, abandoned (for update)

tools.name: comment

componentUuid.description: Component UUID to attach comment to (required for add)

nodeRef.description: Node UUID or name within component (optional for add, defaults to root)
